newsitem.title: USA: Pyrocap says delisting appeal unsuccessful.
newsitem.headline: Pyrocap says delisting appeal unsuccessful.

text.p: Pyrocap International Corp said on Monday that it was not successful in appealing the American Stock Exchange's decision to delist the company's shares.

The exchange told the company it filed a delisting application with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission and that the final day of trading for the shares on the American Stock Exchange would be November 29, Pyrocap said.

Pyrocap, which makes environmentally friendly chemicals, said it planned to take steps to have its common stock quoted in the NASD's Electronic Bulletin Board, and it anticipated an over-the-counter market would develop following its removal from the American Stock Exchange.
But the company, which was not immediately available for further comment, said it could not guarantee such a market would develop.
